lines.text: The high priest asks Stephen if the charges are true, and Stephen says God appeared to Abraham in Mesopotamia.
Abraham leaves the land of the Chaldeans, receives no inheritance there, and God gives him the covenant of circumcision.
The patriarchs, jealous of Joseph, sell him into Egypt, where Pharaoh makes him commander of the army.

wrong_details.true: ruler over Egypt and all his household

lines.text: A new king oppresses Israel, Pharaoh's daughter raises Moses, and after Moses kills an Egyptian, he flees to Moab.
God speaks to Moses from a burning bush near Mount Sinai, but the fathers make a calf and God threatens exile beyond Babylon.
